headline: Make the room lean in.
visual: A layered cascade of actual presentation screenshots resolves into the All Hands product mark. Large editorial type, confident fast entrance, then hold.
voice: Ideas deserve more than another ordinary slide. Meet All Hands.

headline: Your ideas. In focus.
visual: Real editor full view, then a continuous punch into Title, typing Ideas in motion, with the live preview updating. Cursor press and restrained keyboard ticks.
voice: Start with your story. Edit titles and text, organize slides, and watch your live preview take shape.

headline: Build with the right pieces.
visual: Actual content editor and object cards. Text, bullets, metric, quote, image labels arrive with card motion; show add or selection, size and visibility controls.
voice: Bring text, bullet points, metrics, quotes, and images together. Resize, reorder, duplicate, or hide the pieces you need.

headline: Give every detail a place.
visual: Actual image settings and rendered image detail dialog. A supplied generated stage image is uploaded into the real demo deck. Crop / contain / expand labels with pointer actions.
voice: Upload your own visuals. Control how images fit, then let the audience open them for a closer look.

headline: One story. Many possibilities.
visual: Three actual slide screenshots on a choreographed gallery: business update, quote, activity/quiz. Themes and layout chooser proof. No claims of AI generation.
voice: Choose layouts and themes for team updates, activities, quotes, quizzes, and more. Keep every section part of the story.

headline: Own the moment.
visual: Real live viewer toolbar punch, keyboard arrows to next slide, Notes opens. Fullscreen and blank shortcuts appear as accurate editorial labels. Clock/elapsed cropped proof.
voice: Present with keyboard controls, speaker notes, fullscreen, and a blank screen when you need the room. Track the session at a glance.

headline: More ways to tell it.
visual: Real Story view scrolling through slide panels, then actual Movie mode with group gallery and cursor selecting Design Team.
voice: Move through your deck as a scrolling story. Or open Movie mode and jump straight into the group you want.

headline: Keep the energy moving.
visual: Actual timer choose one minute, Start, countdown, Pause, +30 sec. Time typography oversized with accurate helper labels.
voice: Keep activities on track with a built-in timer. Pick a preset or custom duration. Pause, resume, restart, or add thirty seconds.

headline: Your work. Saved locally.
visual: Real Save to Local File action and saved on disk status. Graphical local JSON file anchored to actual editor capture; undo and redo callouts.
voice: Save your presentation to a local file. Undo and redo while you edit, and keep an editable JSON copy for later.

headline: Send a whole experience.
visual: Actual Export Web ZIP action, then labeled three-step process ZIP → Extract → double-click Open Presentation.html. Actual offline HTML opens to same presentation screenshot. Must state email attachment, not automatic send.
voice: Export a web ZIP and email it. Extract, then double-click Open Presentation. Your live deck, images, and modes open offline.

headline: Made for your next big idea.
visual: Actual hero slide with elegant All Hands mark, three audience tags Teams / Teachers / Creators, final stable hold. No external creator attribution or open-source mention.
voice: For teams, classrooms, workshops, and creative pitches. Make it memorable. All Hands.
